sentences.text: At seven thirty you take two bearings, a light at three five two true and a tower at one zero eight true, and plot the fix where the lines cross.
Your seven thirty DR is six miles along zero six eight from your departure, since you’ve run half an hour at twelve knots.
The fix lies point eight miles from the DR, bearing one six zero true from it.
So the current sets one six zero true, with a drift of point eight miles divided by half an hour, or one point six knots.
